```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("mag_annotate")

ma <- function(...) p("results", "mag_annotate", ...)
read_if <- function(tool, path, ...) load_tool(tool, if (file.exists(path)) read_table_quiet(path, ...) else NULL, otherwise = NULL)

checkm2 <- read_if("CheckM2", ma("checkm2", "quality_report.tsv"))
gtdbtk <- read_if("GTDB-Tk", ma("gtdbtk", "gtdbtk.summary.tsv"))
quast <- read_if("QUAST", ma("quast", "report.tsv"))
dram_stats <- read_if("DRAM", ma("dram", "genome_stats.tsv"))

# MIMAG needs rRNA and tRNA genes for "high quality", and only DRAM's table has those
mimag_class <- function(completeness, contamination) {
  case_when(
    completeness >= 90 & contamination < 5 ~ "High",
    completeness >= 50 & contamination < 10 ~ "Medium",
    TRUE ~ "Low"
  )
}
genomes <- load_tool("CheckM2", if (!is.null(checkm2)) {
  table <- checkm2 %>%
    mutate(genome = sub("\\.fa(\\.gz)?$", "", Name), quality = mimag_class(Completeness, Contamination))
  if (!is.null(gtdbtk)) {
    taxonomy <- gtdbtk %>%
      transmute(genome = sub("\\.fa(\\.gz)?$", "", user_genome), classification)
    table <- left_join(table, taxonomy, by = "genome")
  }
  table
} else {
  tibble()
})

rank_of <- function(classification, prefix) {
  pattern <- paste0("(^|;)", prefix, "__[^;]*")
  found <- regmatches(classification, regexpr(pattern, classification))
  value <- rep(NA_character_, length(classification))
  value[grepl(pattern, classification)] <- sub(paste0("^;?", prefix, "__"), "", found)
  value
}
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  sentences <- c(
    if (nrow(genomes) > 0) {
      counts <- table(factor(genomes$quality, levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low")))
      paste0("**", plural(nrow(genomes), "genome"), "** ", if (nrow(genomes) == 1) "was" else "were", " assessed with CheckM2: ", counts[["High"]], " high, ", counts[["Medium"]], " medium and ", counts[["Low"]],
             " low quality by completeness and contamination. Mean completeness is ", fmt_pct(mean(genomes$Completeness)), ", mean contamination ", fmt_pct(mean(genomes$Contamination)), ".")
    },
    if (!is.null(gtdbtk)) {
      phyla <- rank_of(gtdbtk$classification, "p")
      species <- rank_of(gtdbtk$classification, "s")
      paste0("GTDB-Tk placed the genomes in ", n_distinct(phyla[!is.na(phyla) & nzchar(phyla)]), " phyla, and ", sum(is.na(species) | !nzchar(species)), " of ", nrow(gtdbtk),
             " have no species in GTDB, so they may be new species.")
    },
    if (!is.null(quast)) {
      paste0("QUAST described the catalogue: ", paste(quast[[1]][quast[[1]] %in% c("N50", "Total length")], fmt_int(as.numeric(quast[[2]][quast[[1]] %in% c("N50", "Total length")])), sep = " ", collapse = ", "), ".")
    }
  )
  if (length(sentences) > 0) bullets(sentences) else para("No genome annotation results were found yet.")
})
```

```{r checkm2}
section("Genome quality with CheckM2", {
  if (nrow(genomes) == 0) {
    no_output("CheckM2", "results/mag_annotate/checkm2/quality_report.tsv")
  } else {
    para(
      "CheckM2 estimates completeness and contamination by machine learning from gene content. The classes here follow the MIMAG standard (Bowers et al. 2017) for those two values only: ",
      "**High** is at least 90% complete with less than 5% contamination, **Medium** at least 50% with less than 10%, and **Low** is the rest. MIMAG's high-quality class also requires ",
      "rRNA and tRNA genes, and the DRAM section below has those."
    )
    show_table(
      genomes %>% arrange(desc(Completeness - 5 * Contamination)) %>% transmute(
        Genome = genome, Class = quality, Completeness = fmt_num(Completeness), Contamination = fmt_num(Contamination), Size = fmt_bp(Genome_Size),
        N50 = fmt_int(Contig_N50), GC = fmt_num(100 * GC_Content), Genes = fmt_int(Total_Coding_Sequences)
      ),
      "Quality of the genomes, the best first",
      "genome_quality",
      export = genomes,
      max_rows = 40
    )
    show_figure(
      ggplot(genomes, aes(Contamination, Completeness, colour = quality, size = Genome_Size / 1e6)) +
        annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 5, ymin = 90, ymax = Inf, fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.08) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(High = "#009E73", Medium = "#E69F00", Low = "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
        scale_size_continuous(name = "Size (Mb)", range = c(0.8, 4)) +
        labs(x = "Contamination (%)", y = "Completeness (%)") +
        theme_report(),
      "genome_quality",
      "Completeness and contamination of each genome. The shaded area holds high-quality genomes.",
      height = 3.6
    )
    show_figure(
      ggplot(genomes, aes(Genome_Size / 1e6, fill = quality)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(High = "#009E73", Medium = "#E69F00", Low = "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = "Genome size (Mb)", y = "Genomes") +
        theme_report(),
      "genome_sizes",
      "Size of the genomes. Incomplete genomes are shorter than the organism's real genome.",
      height = 2.6
    )
  }
})
```

```{r gtdbtk}
section("Taxonomy with GTDB-Tk", {
  if (is.null(gtdbtk)) {
    no_output("GTDB-Tk", "results/mag_annotate/gtdbtk/gtdbtk.summary.tsv")
  } else {
    table <- gtdbtk %>%
      transmute(
        genome = user_genome, classification,
        domain = rank_of(classification, "d"), phylum = rank_of(classification, "p"), class = rank_of(classification, "c"),
        order = rank_of(classification, "o"), family = rank_of(classification, "f"), genus = rank_of(classification, "g"), species = rank_of(classification, "s"),
        ani = if ("closest_genome_ani" %in% names(gtdbtk)) closest_genome_ani else if ("closest_placement_ani" %in% names(gtdbtk)) closest_placement_ani else NA
      )
    write_tsv(table, file.path(ctx$tables, "taxonomy.tsv"), na = "")
    para("GTDB-Tk places each genome in the GTDB tree. A genome with an empty species has no close relative in GTDB, which often means a new species. An empty genus is rarer, and points further.")
    levels_table <- tibble(
      Rank = c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
      `Distinct taxa` = map_int(list(table$phylum, table$class, table$order, table$family, table$genus, table$species), ~ n_distinct(.x[!is.na(.x) & nzchar(.x)])),
      `Genomes without a name` = map_int(list(table$phylum, table$class, table$order, table$family, table$genus, table$species), ~ sum(is.na(.x) | !nzchar(.x)))
    )
    show_table(levels_table, "Taxa among the genomes, per rank", "taxa_per_rank")
    phyla <- table %>% count(phylum, sort = TRUE) %>% mutate(phylum = ifelse(is.na(phylum) | !nzchar(phylum), "(no name)", phylum))
    show_figure(
      phyla %>% head(25) %>% mutate(phylum = reorder(phylum, n)) %>%
        ggplot(aes(n, phylum)) +
        geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[3]]) +
        labs(x = "Genomes", y = NULL) +
        theme_report(),
      "genomes_per_phylum",
      "Genomes per phylum, from GTDB-Tk.",
      height = rows_height(min(nrow(phyla), 25), 0.2, 1)
    )
    show_table(
      table %>% count(phylum, family, genus, sort = TRUE) %>% transmute(Phylum = phylum, Family = family, Genus = genus, Genomes = n),
      "The most frequent genera among the genomes",
      "genera",
      max_rows = 20
    )
  }
})
```

```{r dram}
section("Metabolism with DRAM", {
  if (is.null(dram_stats)) {
    no_output("DRAM", "results/mag_annotate/dram/genome_stats.tsv")
  } else {
    para("DRAM annotates genes against several databases and summarizes them as metabolic functions. `results/mag_annotate/dram/product.html` is its interactive heat map, and ",
         "`metabolism_summary.xlsx` has all genes behind it.")
    show_table(dram_stats, "Genome statistics from DRAM, with rRNA and tRNA genes for MIMAG's high-quality class", "dram_genome_stats", max_rows = 30)
    product <- read_if("DRAM", ma("dram", "product.tsv"))
    if (!is.null(product)) {
      write_tsv(product, file.path(ctx$tables, "dram_product.tsv"))
      numeric_columns <- names(product)[map_lgl(product, ~ is.numeric(.x) || is.logical(.x))]
      if (length(numeric_columns) > 0 && nrow(product) > 0) {
        per_function <- product %>%
          mutate(across(all_of(numeric_columns), as.numeric)) %>%
          summarise(across(all_of(numeric_columns), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
          pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Function", values_to = "mean") %>%
          arrange(desc(mean))
        show_table(
          per_function %>% transmute(Function = Function, `Mean over genomes` = fmt_num(mean, 2)),
          "Functions with the highest mean score over all genomes, from DRAM's product table",
          "dram_functions",
          export = per_function,
          max_rows = 25
        )
      }
    }
  }
})
```

```{r bakta}
section("Genome annotation with Bakta", {
  file <- ma("bakta", "bakta.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    no_output("Bakta", "results/mag_annotate/bakta/bakta.tsv")
  } else {
    lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
    header <- grep("^#Sequence Id", lines)[1]
    rows <- lines[(header + 1):length(lines)]
    table <- read_tsv(I(paste(c(sub("^#", "", lines[header]), rows), collapse = "\n")), show_col_types = FALSE)
    by_type <- count(table, Type, sort = TRUE)
    para("Bakta annotates the catalogue with a curated database of bacterial genes. The per-genome tables are in `results/mag_annotate/bakta_mags/`.")
    show_table(by_type %>% transmute(`Feature type` = Type, Features = fmt_int(n)), "Features that Bakta found in the catalogue", "bakta_features", export = by_type)
    products <- table %>% filter(Type == "cds") %>% mutate(hypothetical = grepl("hypothetical", Product, ignore.case = TRUE))
    if (nrow(products) > 0) {
      para(fmt_pct(100 * mean(products$hypothetical)), " of the coding sequences are hypothetical proteins, without a known function.")
    }
  }
})
```

```{r others}
section("Other annotations", {
  camper <- read_if("CAMPER", ma("camper", "annotations.tsv"))
  if (is.null(camper)) {
    no_output("CAMPER", "results/mag_annotate/camper/annotations.tsv")
  } else {
    hits <- camper %>% filter(!is.na(CAMPER_hits), nzchar(CAMPER_hits))
    para("**CAMPER** (polyphenol metabolism): ", fmt_int(nrow(hits)), " of ", fmt_int(nrow(camper)), " genes have a hit.")
    if (nrow(hits) > 0 && "CAMPER_definition" %in% names(hits)) {
      show_table(count(hits, CAMPER_definition, sort = TRUE) %>% transmute(Definition = CAMPER_definition, Genes = fmt_int(n)), "The most frequent CAMPER functions", "camper_functions", max_rows = 15)
    }
  }
  ortho <- ma("proteinortho", "proteinortho.proteinortho.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(ortho)) {
    no_output("Proteinortho", "results/mag_annotate/proteinortho/")
  } else {
    table <- read_tsv(ortho, show_col_types = FALSE)
    names(table)[1] <- "species"
    per_size <- count(table, species)
    para("**Proteinortho** found ", fmt_int(nrow(table)), " groups of orthologous proteins. Each input is the set of MAGs of one assembly, so assemblies that share reads aren't independent.")
    show_figure(
      ggplot(per_size, aes(species, n)) +
        geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[1]]) +
        labs(x = "Genomes in the group", y = "Groups of orthologs") +
        theme_report(),
      "orthogroups",
      "Groups of orthologous proteins by the number of genomes in them. Groups in all genomes are the core genome.",
      height = 2.8
    )
    write_tsv(per_size, file.path(ctx$tables, "orthogroups_per_size.tsv"))
  }
  eggnog <- Sys.glob(ma("eggnog", "*"))
  if (length(eggnog) == 0) {
    no_output("eggNOG-mapper", "results/mag_annotate/eggnog/")
  } else {
    seeds <- grep("seed_orthologs$", eggnog, value = TRUE)
    if (length(seeds) > 0) {
      n <- sum(map_int(seeds, ~ sum(!startsWith(readLines(.x, warn = FALSE), "#"))))
      para("**eggNOG-mapper** found homologs for ", fmt_int(n), " proteins. This rule only searches for homologs, so there are no functional classes here.")
    }
  }
  sgb <- ma("phylophlan", "SGB", "SGB.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(sgb)) {
    no_output("PhyloPhlAn", "results/mag_annotate/phylophlan/")
  } else {
    para("**PhyloPhlAn** results are in `results/mag_annotate/phylophlan/SGB/SGB.tsv`, with ", fmt_int(length(readLines(sgb, warn = FALSE)) - 1), " lines.")
  }
})
```

```{r methods}
section("Methods text", {
  para("You can use or adapt this text for a paper. It lists the tools with output in this project. Add database versions from the reference report.")
  f <- ctx$features$databases
  sentences <- c(
    if (nrow(genomes) > 0) paste0("Completeness and contamination were estimated with ", tv("CheckM2"), ", and genomes were classed following the MIMAG standard."),
    if (!is.null(gtdbtk)) paste0("Taxonomy was assigned with ", tv("GTDB-Tk"), " and ", basename(as.character(f$gtdbtk %||% "?")), "."),
    if (!is.null(quast)) paste0("Statistics of the catalogue were computed with ", tv("QUAST"), "."),
    if (!is.null(dram_stats)) paste0("Genes were annotated and metabolism summarized with ", tv("DRAM"), "."),
    if (file.exists(ma("bakta", "bakta.tsv"))) paste0("Genomes were annotated with ", tv("Bakta"), "."),
    if (file.exists(ma("camper", "annotations.tsv"))) paste0("Polyphenol metabolism genes were identified with ", tv("CAMPER"), "."),
    if (file.exists(ma("proteinortho", "proteinortho.proteinortho.tsv"))) paste0("Orthologous groups were computed with ", tv("Proteinortho"), ".")
  )
  if (length(sentences) > 0) para("> ", paste(sentences, collapse = " ")) else para("There is no output to describe yet.")
})
```
